title: Merchant
description: One of the five commerce locations: a board location plus its printed bonus, tile-slot count and activation threshold.

bonus.description: Printed reward, fired once when this location's free beer barrel is consumed.

tile-slots.description: Merchant-tile spaces at this location. Shrewsbury has 1; the other four have 2.

active-from-players.description: Lowest seat count at which this location is in play. Yields 5 / 7 / 9 total tile slots at 2 / 3 / 4 seats.

connects.description: Adjacent city ids as printed. Documentation only: no engine code reads this. Real adjacency is the edge table.
